title: Avomi CLIQ Prefilled Vape Pod + Refill - Orange Soda
description: Designed for the Avomi Cliq Prefilled Pod Kit, Avomi Cliq Prefilled Pods deliver straightforward MTL (mouth-to-lung) vaping with consistent flavour. Each pack combines a 2ml prefilled pod with a 10ml refill container to extend use. Mesh coil technology supports clear flavour and stable vapour. The push-to-refill system helps you top up quickly and cleanly — connect pod and refill, then attach to your Cliq device. Enjoy up to around 6000 puffs per pack depending on use, with 20mg Nicotine Salt for a smooth draw. Orange Soda captures a sparkling citrus profile with sweet orange and a gentle soda fizz character. Once your pod and refill is empty, simply swap them out for a fresh Avomi Cliq Prefilled Pod + Refill pack, View the full range of Avomi Cliq Prefilled pod kits & Refill Pods
